reviewSamples.author: Photo of Janet Pagan
reviewSamples.text:
I was a week in to my post op surgery procedure and i was looking for lymphatic drainage massages.The one I found I had to wait about a week and half I was in a lot of pain looking for better garments I found Palermo Aesthetic and as I walked in this gentlemen name Miguel came out to assist me and told me about all the services they provide one of the most important one for me was the lymphatic drainage massage and took the time to explain to me what the massages consisted of. I took the opportunity as he had an immediate opening and got my massage. After getting my massage I felt a lot better. Miguel is very professional very respectful and what I like the most that he knows a lot about his profession. He makes you feel comfortable to continue to get any service with him.

The facility is very welcoming nice and clean and friendly. Place where they have a lot of services.

Miguel thank you for being who you are a very kind and respectful Man.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Yashira O
reviewSamples.text: I came for the lymphatic drainage service after my abdominal surgery and from day 1 Miguel was very kind and professional. He made me feel so comfortable that I am going for 10 massages with him and I recommend him with my eyes closed.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ana Maria Rueda
reviewSamples.text: My post op drainage massages have been absolutely phenomenal and worth every penny. Miguel is the best. He is so knowledgeable about the healing process and shared lots of tips to ensure I have the best results. He also gave me feedback about what was going on with specific areas of swelling.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of jordan snell
reviewSamples.text: Had lipo 360 with bbl, I had a lot of fluid built up . A lot of my holes were closed and this place was able to drain ALL of it out in one session!! Best $70 I spent! They did better than the therapist at the plastic surgery center I went to. 10/10!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Alanis Maldonado
reviewSamples.text: As I'm writing this review, it is my third appointment with Miguel. From the first moment he has guided me through different options and always looked out of the best option for me. He always answers all my questions and he's very knowledgeable and professional whenever he takes care of me. As I see how he works, it's clear that his client is his first and most important priority. He's a trustworthy esthetician, and very talented on his work, regardless what service he offers. He will always put his best effort on the attention and care I need.
